findings.issue: yarn test:typecheck fails with TS2345 at line 51 because `overrides` in `createStyledText` is typed as `Partial<ExcalidrawTextElement>`, which includes readonly metadata fields (`id`, `version`, `versionNonce`, `updated`) that are not assignable to `ElementUpdate<NonDeleted<ExcalidrawTextElement>>` in `newElementWith`.
findings.fix: Type `overrides` in `createStyledText` as `Omit<Partial<ExcalidrawTextElement>, "id" | "version" | "versionNonce" | "updated"> = {}` (or remove the unused `overrides` parameter) and remove the unnecessary `as any` casts on `mutateElement` and `reconcileElements`.

findings.issue: `actionChangeStrokeColor` and `actionChangeBackgroundColor` are invoked with `{ currentItemStrokeColor }` / `{ currentItemBackgroundColor }` instead of `{ color }`, causing `perform` to return early without modifying `textStyleRanges` while the test only asserts `Array.isArray(current.textStyleRanges)`, and the `// undo/redo` block at line 227 never executes `Keyboard.undo()` or `Keyboard.redo()`.
findings.fix: Pass `{ color: "#e03131" }` and `{ color: "#ffec99" }` (and test splitting, merging, and clearing via `"transparent"` and `#1e1e1e`) to `executeAction` with concrete `expect(current.textStyleRanges).toEqual(...)` assertions, and exercise `Keyboard.undo()` and `Keyboard.redo()` in the undo/redo test.
